decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the information contained in the application details of the coping and new roof to the two-storey rear extension to the building shall be submitted to and approved in writing to the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the works.  The details shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Repairs and minor alterations at roof level alterations to dormer windows and installation of a solar panel to flat roof.
